description.value:
Supposedly once owned by an FIA Special Agent hiding in Night City. Time-worn, tried, tested, and true.

Category: Never look back. (Luxury) • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 21 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes, and at a +3 bonus to Conveal/Reveal Object

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Pistol Long Barrel, Silencer, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine. While charged, this weapon is ROF 1 and deals 2d6 additional damage (4d6). When firing this weapon at a target not in an Initiative Queue or whom has a lower Initiative than you and has not yet taken an Action this combat, it deals 3d6 additional damage (5d6 Normal, 6d6 Charged). If this weapon deals damage to a target via a Head Location Aimed Shot, then for the next 6 seconds (2 Rounds) its Tech Rebuild can be charged without a Move Action and it can be Reloaded without an Action as long as the user has at least one other free hand.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Long Barrel, Silencer, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
